description: Erection of a two storey side extension.
decision_conditions: The development must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date hereof.Reason: To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended.

All external facing materials, treatments and finishes shall be similar to those of the original building. Where this is not possible the type and treatment of the materials to be used shall be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to any above ground works being carried out.  Reason: To ensure that the extension harmonises with the existing building and to ensure compliance with Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Apart from the window to the en-suite bathroom, no further windows shall be installed in the side elevation of the permitted two storey side extension at first floor level.Reason:  To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in accordance with Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The proposed first floor window in the southern side elevation to the en-suite bathroom of the extension hereby approved shall be obscure glazed and non-opening up to a height of 1.7m above floor level prior to its occupation and shall be retained in that form as long as the development is in existence. Reason: To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers and to ensure compliance with Policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development must be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Planning Stage Fire Strategy Statement by BWC Fire Limited (BWC), 27th January 2022 unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.

The description of proposal section of the application form has been completed so that only a loft conversion for the provision of a self contained residential unit is being applied for. However, drawing 24049-OSL-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-030005 Rev P8, 'existing' ground and first floor plans have been titled as consented. This suggests that a previously granted application is yet to be built out or substantially built out. If a previously approved application has not been built or substantially built out as yet it will be necessary to either apply for the previously approved aspects again together with the new proposed development, provide the relevant drawing pack which shows all elements being applied for, required supporting documents and pay the appropriate fee for a change of use and provision of three self contained residential units. Or, withdraw this current application and wait until such time that the previously approved development has been built or substantially out before applying for this new proposal.
Please provide an existing metric scaled (minimum scale 1:100) roof plan as necessary. Existing and proposed roof plans are mandatory if any new roof element is proposed.

In accordance with Sutton's Local Validation List you are required to submit Site Photographs with this application - for help and guidance about what should be included please see https://www.sutton.gov.uk/info/200154/planning_and_building_control/1224/about_the_planning_process#Stage%202 It is appreciated that a site photograph has been provided. However, site photographs should show all sides of the application property where the proposed work will be visible, plus front and rear streetscene photographs showing the application property and the neighbouring properties wherever possible. In addition, the submitted site photograph shows the front entrance porch in situ, therefore, if the development being applied for has not only been started but also completed the relevant sections of the application form will need to be amended accordingly in order to accurately reflect this.

I appreciate that submitting a planning application can be quite daunting without the assistance of an agent. Therefore, to assist you I have provided instructions so that you can view the most recent applications that have been previously submitted to us for the formation of a front entrance porch as the documents required for these applications will be the same/very similar as your application. You can access this by going to our website and doing a wild card search: go to https://planningregister.sutton.gov.uk/online-applications/then in the search box type in *formation of a front entrance porch* this should show you all the applications that have the words *formation of a front entrance porch* in them. Hopefully these examples will assist in what is required to validate your application. Should you experience any further difficulties providing the above documents/information you may be best advised to employ the services of a structural engineer, architect or agent. Please submit all necessary documentation directly to me as attachments via scott.brewer@sutton.gov.uk and I will upload them to the application file for you.
